QuestInfo.name: Eliza's Eternal Slumber
QuestInfo.0: Eliza looked relieved when he heard his puppet was eliminated.
QuestInfo.1: Eliza wanted to sleep until the goddess broke free from Papa Pixie, and she asked for an #binstrument#k to help her sleep. You could play the goddess's harp, but it won't be easy. \r\n The goddess's harp is located to Eliza's left.
QuestInfo.2: Glanced over at #bEliza#k as I finished playing the instrument, and noticed that she is already asleep. Sweet dreams.

0.0: Thank you, adventurer. I feel a little relieved knowing that there is an adventurer that can eliminate those shadows. I must continue my eternal sleep, until my Goddess returns. Eternal sleep.#E \n\n#L0# #bIt will be a very long nap.#k#l
0.1: Yes, of course. Ah... do you like music, adventurer? There is nothing like falling asleep while listening to beautiful music. I used to fall asleep while my Goddess played the harp. I guess it would be difficult.#E \n\n#L0# #bMay I help you?#k#l
0.2: Ah...? You must have profound knowledge in music. Please play for me.

yes.0: This is a book of the goddess's favorite music. Please #bplay it as well as you can#k. The harp is to your left. We're all counting on you to soothe the savage beast...

no.0: Haha... I might have asked a lot from you. Very well. It will take some time, but I will eventually fall asleep.

yes.0: (Eliza seems to be in deep sleep.)

default.0: Play Little Star on the harp to calm Eliza. Did you lose the book? If you give up the quest and then accept again, you can get the book back.

lost.0: Seems you lost a book with the notes to Little Star. Here is another one. Please play it for me.
